topic: 5 minute animal adventure workout for kids
characterReference: selected KM-004 Szene 01 cover reference ONLY
introVoiceText: Hi, KidMotion explorers! Today we're going on a five-minute animal adventure with twelve fun freeze poses. Clear some space, move at your own pace, and stop if anything hurts. Get ready to roar, stretch, balance, and let's begin!

scenes.instruction: Bend low, plant your feet, and show strong arms.

pink-orange lagoon zone with stylized reeds and soft sunset accents
